text.text: NetApp ® All Flash FAS (AFF) systems address enterprise storage requirements with high performance, superior flexibility, and best-in-class data management. Built on ONTAP ® data management software, AFF systems speed up business without compromising on the efficiency, reliability, or flexibility of IT operations. As an enterprise-grade all-flash array, AFF systems optimize I/O and maximize application throughput while running flash-optimizing functions to accelerate a broad range of SAN and NAS workloads.

text.text: NetApp AFF is not only an excellent choice for performance-demanding applications such as Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, and MongoDB databases, VDI, and server virtualization, but also is a great choice for shared environments with a variety of workloads commonly found in a data center. AFF comes with a full suite of acclaimed NetApp Integrated Data Protection software. Key capabilities and benefit include: Native space efficiency with cloning and Snapshot® copies to reduce storage costs and to minimize performance impact Application-consistent backup and recovery that simplify application management Synchronous replication with NetApp MetroClusterTM software, a leading capability in the all- ash array market that delivers zero RPO and near-zero RTO for mission-critical workloads Ability to achieve regulatory compliance with SnapLock®, which is enabled with integrated data protection and storage e ciency NetApp SnapMirror ® replication software, which replicates to any type of FAS/AFF system—all ash, hybrid, or HDD and on the premises or in the cloud—reducing overall system costs

NetApp AFF is not only an excellent choice for performance-demanding applications such as Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, and MongoDB databases, VDI, and server virtualization, but also is a great choice for shared environments with a variety of workloads commonly found in a data center.

AFF comes with a full suite of acclaimed NetApp Integrated Data Protection software. Key capabilities and benefit include:
Native space efficiency with cloning and Snapshot® copies to reduce storage costs and to minimize performance impact
Application-consistent backup and recovery that simplify application management
Synchronous replication with NetApp MetroClusterTM software, a leading capability in the all- ash array market that delivers zero RPO and near-zero RTO for mission-critical workloads
Ability to achieve regulatory compliance with SnapLock®, which is enabled with integrated data protection and storage e ciency
NetApp SnapMirror® replication software, which replicates to any type of FAS/AFF system—all ash, hybrid, or HDD and on the premises or in the cloud—reducing overall system costs

text.text: Designed specifically for flash, the AFF A700 series all-flash systems deliver industry-leading performance, capacity density, scalability, security and network connectivity in a flexible form factor. All Flash FAS systems can be ordered with a factory-configured FC SAN or NAS optimized configuration increasing simplicity and decreasing time to value and cluster creation. With up to 29.7PB of effective capacity, a max of 480 SSDs, 20 PCIe expansion slots, and 1024GB of memory per HA pair, the A700 is an ideal platform for a variety of workloads.

text.text: NetApp ONTAP 9 is the next generation of the industry’s leading data management software. It combines new levels of simplicity and flexibility with powerful data management capabilities and storage efficiencies across flash, disk and cloud. It serves as the foundation for the NetApp Data Fabric allowing customers access to their data wherever it resides. In addition to being available with all AFF systems, ONTAP is also packaged as a virtualize instance and within public hyperscalers.
